environment.description: Rails 7.0 API deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has a listener rule forwarding to the target group with an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL. The Web ACL includes a custom rule group 'content-integrity-enforcement' with a rule that inspects response bodies for script tags and validates presence of integrity attributes (separate from the mass assignment issue). Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/EngineeringServiceBoundary) that restricts the application's database connection to use a PostgreSQL role with a row-level security policy: the 'api_service' DB role has a column-level UPDATE privilege grant that explicitly excludes the 'role' and 'is_admin' columns on the users table (GRANT UPDATE(name, email, avatar_url) ON users TO api_service). The RDS instance parameter group has 'pgaudit.log' set to 'write' for compliance logging. The SRI tags in the layout ensure that even if an attacker compromises the CDN, tampered JavaScript (which might attempt to craft malicious API requests) cannot execute in browsers that enforce SRI.

config.sri_enforcement: browser-level via integrity attributes on all script tags
config.db_privileges: GRANT UPDATE(name, email, avatar_url) ON users TO api_service
config.rls_policy: column-level privilege restriction on users table
